listening.title: Buổi họp phòng ban đầu tuần

lines.speaker: Hoa (Department Head)
lines.text: Good morning, everyone. I'll chair the meeting today, so let's go through the agenda items quickly.

lines.speaker: Minh (Marketing staff)
lines.text: Sounds good. Did everyone get the department update I sent yesterday?

lines.speaker: Hoa (Department Head)
lines.text: Yes, thanks. Let's start with the first agenda item about the new campaign.

lines.speaker: Minh (Marketing staff)
lines.text: Sure. This project needs a cross-departmental effort with the design team.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Department Head)
lines.text: Good point. Did you book a meeting room for that discussion?

lines.speaker: Minh (Marketing staff)
lines.text: Not yet, I'll do it right after this meeting.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Department Head)
lines.text: Great. Please don't go off-topic, we only have thirty minutes today.

lines.speaker: Minh (Marketing staff)
lines.text: Understood. I'll keep my updates short and focused.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Department Head)
lines.text: If you want to take the floor, just raise your hand.

lines.speaker: Minh (Marketing staff)
lines.text: Got it. I think we're close to a meeting overrun, so let's wrap up.
